responsibility: This generated parser implementation performs pass 1 of the mc front end. It recognizes the full Modula-2 grammar with recovery stop sets, drives the token stream from mcLexBuf, establishes module and procedure scopes, records root declarations, imports, and module identity information in decl nodes, and does the initial syntax-shaping work needed for later semantic passes while tolerating enough errors for reparsing, making it the first structural and lexical-analysis pass of the compiler pipeline.
same_name_distinction: This .cc file is the generated pass-1 parser implementation itself, containing the grammar procedures, token recovery logic, and first-pass semantic actions such as establishing module/procedure context and imports. The same-stem header only declares the pass entry point.
